'''2013 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event in New Brunswick, New Jersey, 24–27 January 2013, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=755</ref> [[Steve Baroni]] won the championship.<ref name="winner">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=49932</ref> The published list is the MPC PDF on the Players Committee decklist desk. Dates on the Day 1 sheets are 26 January 2013. The name field on pages 11–12 is Baroni; that player is Steve Baroni. Day 1 sheets whose name field is a last name, first name, last initial, or otherwise incomplete are listed with the name as written.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' New Brunswick, New Jersey
* '''Dates:''' 24–27 January 2013
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
